text:
Useless flight: the moon has already lost your spirit

and your song already has

silence for its wake.

Soon, rained star, vessel of nothing,


you will cloud some flowers or the gleam of a stone.


Not a murmur, not a tear multiplies your death,

not a sigh

sadly gives echo to your beak:

no one feels that you lose your place in the

air

and that, just as fish sleep among the waves

and men

within the earth, you have no rest

in the blue winds that

caress your wings.


And the clouds already know it is your last,

and that soon your mouth the

song of your life

will sing silently: but they keep their weeping,


but they keep their weeping for the olive groves.

translation.title: Your Plant
translation.editorial_note: The catalog title differs from the elegy-like bird text, so the translated body follows the source text.
